typography.conversion: fontSize=sourcePixelSize*0.75 because UI Theme.FontSize multiplies by4/3
typography.measurement: Offline FreeType/Pillow character advance measurement with original LongZhuTi font, ported kinsoku rules; no engine rendering or build performed.

coordinates.density: factor=clamp((1200/1)/896,0.85,2.5)=1.3392857142857142; scale=dpr*factor; gameW=540/scale=403.2; gameH=1200/scale=896; no wide-screen crop
coordinates.safe: Paper.safeArea: ratio=UI.GetScale()/(dpr*Density.getFactor()); safe UI insets*ratio minus centered offsetX for left/right
coordinates.card: margin=clamp(screenW*0.04,14,22)=16.128; boxW=min(480,available-2*margin)=370.944; boxX=16.128; portraitW=clamp(boxW*0.28,78,112)=103.86432; textAreaW=boxW-40-portraitW-14=213.07968; textAreaX=boxX+20+portraitW+14=153.99232 for NPC; textH=2*27=54; boxH=20+38+max(82,textH)+64=204; boxY=896-safe.bottom-24-boxH=668
coordinates.portrait: NPC portraitX=boxX+20; portraitY=boxY+30; portrait height=boxH-54=150; backgroundFit=contain reproduces Paper.portrait
coordinates.text: nameY=boxY+20; textY=boxY+58; footerY=boxY+boxH-48; hintY=footerY+15; counter right aligned at textAreaX+textAreaW, nameY+4
coordinates.foxVariant: isFox switches portraitX to boxX+boxW-20-portraitW and textAreaX to boxX+20; portrait image comes from current OutfitManager texture, not NPC_TEXTURES

dialogue-text.variable: line.text -> resolveVars(levelVars_) -> kinsoku.wrapNvg -> utf8Sub(charCount_) until complete
dialogue-text.sourceText: 欢迎来到智慧花园！我是慧慧。

bindings.dialogue-portrait: SPEAKER_ROLES[speaker]; npcImages_[role] or foxImage_; sample Textures/character/owl.png

dialogue-hint.variable: lineComplete_ and (lineIdx_<#lines_ and '点击继续' or '点击关闭') or '轻点显示全部'

responsiveConstraints: Root is numeric effective canvas for editor; Density recomputes gameW/H at runtime.
Bottom card remains bottom=24, horizontally centered with equal percentage margins=4% while below max480; original clamp formula retained above.
Text wrapping and card height must be recalculated from full dialogue text before typewriter animation to avoid jumping.
behaviorsRemainLua: whole-screen handleClick reveals full line or advances/finishes sequence
speaker-based portrait side and outfit selection
limitations: Standalone overlay only; underlying adventure map is not duplicated.
Pen.plaque irregular paper contour and its shadow are approximated by plain Panel borders/shadow Panel; Pen.rule and name underline are straight Panel strips.
The orange advance plaque is retained as an empty Button; its NanoVG stroke chevron is omitted, not serialized as a fabricated drawing node. Existing text hint still carries the action meaning.
Static sample covers one real dialogue line; other speaker/typing/end states are documented bindings, not new narrative text.
